events.title: Demo Update: Clearer Information, Smoother Operations & UI Fixes
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has been playing the ApocalypseHQ demo and sharing detailed feedback, screenshots, and bug reports. This update focuses on making the game easier to understand and more comfortable to manage, while addressing several frustrating interface issues. RESEARCH AND PERSONNEL WINDOWS Improved the researcher assignment window with an accessible close button at the top and more reliable Esc handling. Fixed lingering researcher windows and overlays when returning to the main menu

events.title: You Asked for a Clearer Start — Demo Update 1.0.3 Is Live
events.summary: Hello everyone,You told us the screen was packed with information and asked for a proper tutorial. We heard you. Demo Update 1.0.3 rebuilds its 34-step tutorial around actions, not text.A new game now starts with two empty plots. You build the farm and the laboratory yourself, then recruit your first squad, assign them, search, and clear — every step taught by doing it. events.title: ApocalypseHQ — Playable Demo is live at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Civilization has fallen. Headquarters still has another day to survive. ApocalypseHQ is a turn-based zombie-apocalypse management game. Every turn is one day — keep your people fed today while building the base that survives tomorrow. The demo is playable right now, free, until October 26. ▶ Play the demo & add to wishlist This is a pre-release build — tell me what feels broken or confusing in the comments. I read every one.
